properties.html: A steamer can go 76 km downstream and 8 km upstream in 3hours 40minutes and It can also travel 36 km downstream and same distance upstream in 3hours 45minutes. Because of a medical emergency situation, the steamer will have to cover a distance of 60 km upstream in maximum 3 hours to rescue the person. Considering the minimum required speed in upstream, what is the percentage increase in speed of upstream?

properties.html: In a boat race of 60 km, two boats A and B float along the stream at a speed of 20 kmph and 25 kmph respectively. When the race begins at 12 noon, due to engine failure Boat B starts after 1 hour of boat A. After completing the first lap when boat A starts journey against the stream, both boats meet somewhere in the track. If the speed of stream is 7.5 kmph, when will both the boats meet?

properties.html: In a Lagoon of 500 km two speedboat give shuttle services to customers. Consider P goes from A to B and Q goes from B to A and after completing one way both boats can go in reverse direction . Water flows from A to B at a speed of 10 kmph. When both the boats will meet for second time? [given, speed of boat P in still water is 40 kmph and speed of boat Q in still water is 20 kmph]

properties.html: In a river, two banks are 300 km apart, where three boats X, Y,Z are available for passengers. After X, boat Y leaves at 15 minutes interval and After Y, boat Z leaves at 30 minutes interval. The speed of Boat X,Y,Z are 12 kmph, 22 kmph, 42 kmph respectively. The speed of Stream is 8 kmph and all boats are travelling downstream. What will be ratio of boat X & boat Y meeting time and boat Y & boat Z meeting time (Calculated from the beginning or the start of boat X)?

properties.html: Two cruises X and Y are travelling towards each other from points A and B, respectively in a river in which water flows from A to B at a speed of 4 km/hr. The speed of boat X in still water is 10 km/hr less than the speed of boat Y in still water and the distance between point A and point B is 259 km. Both start at the same time and the boat Y meets boat X at 133 km away from point B. Find the time taken by both boats to meet each other.
